verdict.rationale: Letta's core stateful-agent model persists memory across sessions/computers so agents resume where they left off (letta-docs-24, letta-docs-7), and 'dreaming' background subagents review recent conversations and consolidate lessons into memory (letta-docs-27, letta-docs-3), effectively producing session summaries; /doctor also audits memory drift (letta-docs-10) and community posts corroborate the memory-first design (letta-comm-5, letta-comm-12). Missing for 10: explicit user-facing 'session summary' artifact/command and independent hands-on evidence of summary quality across long conversations.
